# SillyTavern 1.19.1

A small patch release with security and robustness fixes. Updating is recommended for everyone.

## Fixes

* Fixed the handling of `<style>` blocks in chat messages and creator notes, which could let crafted content from a character card, an imported chat or a model response run scripts in the app.
* Fixed CharX and BYAF imports of characters with an unusable name placing asset files next to other character cards, where they could replace them.
* Fixed the user backup and delete endpoints accepting handles that are not existing users.

Security advisories with details will be published alongside this release. Thanks to the researchers who reported these issues.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/SillyTavern/SillyTavern/compare/1.19.0...1.19.1
